mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD B WHERE B.BOARD_CODE = 'FREE' AND B.STATUS = 'A'
AND (B.TITLE LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%' OR B.CONTENT LIKE '%' || #{search} || '%')

SELECT B.BOARD_NO, B.TITLE AS BOARD_TITLE, B.CONTENT AS BOARD_CONTENT, B.VIEW_COUNT AS READ_COUNT, B.STATUS AS BOARD_DEL_FL, B.MEMBER_NO, TO_CHAR(B.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, TO_CHAR(B.UPDATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS UPDATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS MEMBER_PROFILE, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM COMMENT_TBL C WHERE C.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO AND C.STATUS = 'A') AS COMMENT_COUNT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) AS LIKE_COUNT,
(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BOARD_LIKE BL WHERE BL.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO AND BL.MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo}) AS IS_LIKED,
0 AS IS_LIKED,
(SELECT LISTAGG(BI.IMAGE_URL, ',') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY BI.IMAGE_ORDER) FROM BOARD_IMAGE BI WHERE BI.BOARD_NO = B.BOARD_NO) AS IMAGE_URLS FROM BOARD B JOIN MEMBER M ON B.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE B.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND B.BOARD_CODE = 'FREE' AND B.STATUS = 'A'
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_BOARD_NO.CURRVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO BOARD (BOARD_NO, BOARD_CODE, TITLE, CONTENT, MEMBER_NO) VALUES ( SEQ_BOARD_NO.NEXTVAL, 'FREE', #{boardTitle}, #{boardContent}, #{memberNo} )
INSERT INTO BOARD_IMAGE (IMAGE_NO, BOARD_NO, IMAGE_URL, IMAGE_ORDER) VALUES (SEQ_BOARD_IMG_NO.NEXTVAL, #{boardNo}, #{imageUrl}, #{imageOrder})
mapper.select: SELECT C.COMMENT_NO, C.BOARD_NO, C.MEMBER_NO, C.PARENT_COMMENT_NO, C.CONTENT, C.STATUS, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS MEMBER_PROFILE FROM COMMENT_TBL C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.BOARD_NO = #{boardNo} AND C.PARENT_COMMENT_NO IS NULL AND C.STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NO ASC

SELECT C.COMMENT_NO, C.BOARD_NO, C.MEMBER_NO, C.PARENT_COMMENT_NO, C.CONTENT, C.STATUS, TO_CHAR(C.CREATED_AT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS CREATED_AT, M.NICKNAME AS MEMBER_NICKNAME, M.PROFILE_IMAGE AS MEMBER_PROFILE FROM COMMENT_TBL C JOIN MEMBER M ON C.MEMBER_NO = M.MEMBER_NO WHERE C.PARENT_COMMENT_NO = #{parentCommentNo} AND C.STATUS = 'A' ORDER BY C.COMMENT_NO ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO COMMENT_TBL (COMMENT_NO, BOARD_NO, MEMBER_NO, PARENT_COMMENT_NO, CONTENT) VALUES ( SEQ_COMMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{boardNo}, #{memberNo}, #{parentCommentNo}, #{content} )
INSERT INTO BOARD_LIKE (LIKE_NO, BOARD_NO, MEMBER_NO) VALUES (SEQ_BOARD_LIKE_NO.NEXTVAL, #{boardNo}, #{memberNo})
